AppearanceOverride

Attachment

ClientConfig

ClientEyeRuntime
Loader-neutral owner of client eye trackers and their simulation lifecycle.
ClientIntegrationFailures
Logs recoverable client integration failures once while allowing affected eyes to be skipped.
ClientLifecycle
Per-tick and disconnect housekeeping for client-side eye state, shared by every loader's client hooks.
ClientNetworkHandler
Applies the three server-to-client payloads on the client game thread.
ClientRenderLayers
Installs vanilla-model, picker, and optional GeckoLib eye layers after renderer rebuilds.
ConfigValue<T>
Mutable, validated runtime view of a loader-owned configuration value.
ContentRegistrar
Loader-neutral registration boundary for the mod's four content registries.

Stable common handle bound once to the supplier owned by the active loader.
EntityPersistentData
Returns the mod-owned persistent compound attached to an entity.
EyeAppearance
The concrete, placement-independent look of an eye: cornea color, iris color, and whether it glows.
EyeAttachmentResolver
Strategy for getting from an entity model's base render pose into the animated space of a named attachment part, so eyes can be drawn relative to it.
EyeBehavior
One named eye expression (stare, blink, grow, …).
EyeBehaviors
The registry of eye behaviors — the seven expressions a mob can play, keyed by id.
EyeBehaviorTriggerPacket
Server → client: "play behavior behaviorId on entity entityId for duration ticks, seeded with seed." Sent to a mob's trackers when the server scheduler starts a behavior (and to a newly-tracking player mid-effect, with the remaining duration), so every viewer animates the same thing in lock-step.
EyeColor
One RGB color, each channel 0..1.
EyeConfigLimits
Shared semantic and work-budget validation for authored and synchronized eye geometry.

EyeConfigModel
The complete eye-definition data model shared by datapack loading, runtime selection, network synchronization, and picker export.
EyeConfigModel.ConfigFile
Raw datapack file structure (one file per entity).
EyeConfigModel.HeadConfig
One head attachment and the eyes placed on it.
EyeConfigModel.RuntimeConfig
Runtime structure selected by version and age, then synchronized to clients.
EyeConfigModel.RuntimeConfigSet
The adult, baby, and age-independent runtime configs for one entity type.
EyeConfigModel.Variant
One weighted placement arrangement.
EyeConfigModel.VersionedEntry
One version- and age-selectable entry in a datapack file.
EyeConfigReloadListener
Loads eye geometry configs from datapacks: scans data/<namespace>/eyes/*.json, one file per entity (the file path is the entity id).
EyeConfigSyncPacket
Server-to-client synchronization of the complete resolved eye-definition set, plus the current googlyEyesEnabled master switch.
EyeDefinition
The complete datapack description of one eye on a mob: its EyePlacement (where/how big/aimed) plus its EyeAppearance (color/glow).
EyeDraft
Mutable working copy of one eye while authoring in the picker.
EyeInfluence
What a single active EyeBehavior exerts on one eye for one simulation tick (not one frame).
EyeInspector
Client action-bar verdict for whether the aimed entity can currently receive googly eyes.
EyeItemProperties
The component-backed appearance carried by an eye-bearing item.
EyeItemService
Loader-neutral implementation of applying and harvesting googly-eye items.
EyeModifier
One "what does this ingredient do to an eye" rule, used by EyeModifierRecipe.
EyeModifier.DyeEyeModifier
1 eye + 1 of the 16 vanilla dyes → that dye's color on the iris (set, not blended).
EyeModifier.GlowEyeModifier
Glowstone dust → make the eye glow (explicit on, overriding config).
EyeModifier.StripEyeModifier
Cobweb → strip every override, leaving a bare eye that falls back to config appearance.
EyeModifier.UnglowEyeModifier
Redstone dust → turn the glow off (explicit off, overriding config).
EyeModifierRecipe
Special crafting recipe that edits a harvested/looted googly eye's appearance: exactly one googly_eye plus exactly one ingredient recognized by an EyeModifier.
EyePlacement
The placement (geometry) of a single eye on a mob: offset from the attach joint, sizes, and aim.
EyeRenderData
Per-frame eye decision for one living entity, taken while its render state is extracted and read back by the eye layers, which see only the render state.
EyeRenderData.Holder
Implemented on LivingEntityRenderState by the mod's render-state mixin.
EyeRenderGating
The single "should this mob show eyes, and with what geometry" gate.
EyeRenderTransforms
Rendering transforms that orient an eye's local pupil axis from its authored placement angles.
EyeState
Per-mob, mutable, mid-life eye state — the override layer that sits on top of the shared datapack config (EyeConfigModel).
EyeState.Snapshot
The full portable state synchronized for one living entity.
EyeStatePacket
Server → client sync of a single entity's full eye state: the hasGooglyEyes flag, the chosen placement-variant roll, plus the optional per-mob appearance overrides (see EyeState).
EyeStateSync
Sends coherent eye-state snapshots through the cross-loader network, either to one newly tracking player or to the entity's complete tracking set.
GeckoCompat
Loader bridge for the optional GeckoLib renderer integration.
Gizmo
Draws the Blockbench/Blender-style transform gizmo for the selected part: RGB = XYZ axes (3 blocks each way), a cube only on each positive end, and an origin marker.

LookTarget

Loader-installed native send operations and the physical-client receive handoff.
PickerExporter
Turns picker drafts into datapack JSON.
PickerExportPacket
Client → server: "write this authored eye config for entityTypeId into the world datapack and reload" — the wire half of /sg export.
PickerExportService
Server-side half of /sg export (reached via PickerExportPacket): validates a client-authored eye config, writes it as canonical datapack JSON into the world's somegoogly-picker pack, and /reloads so it persists and re-syncs through the normal path.
PickerFreezePacket
Client → server: "freeze the mob I'm editing" (or release it).
PickerFreezeService
Server-owned picker mob freezing: a picker-targeted mob is held NoAi=true while edited and restored to its pre-picker value when released.
PickerGate
Server-side authorization and throttling for client-driven picker operations — the two halves of the same gate, always checked together by the packet handlers.
PickerHud
Text HUD for the part picker: a live, read-only view of the locked mob, the selected part, and the saved eye list (two lines per eye), with the eye currently being edited via /sg highlighted.
PickerInput
Routes key presses to PickerState while the picker is active.
PickerKeys
Keybindings for the in-world part picker.
PickerLayer<S,M>
Picker preview layer: renders the committed eyes plus the live draft eye and the selection gizmo, but only for the entity the picker is locked onto.
PickerSpawnService
Authoring aid behind /sg spawnall: spawns one of every mob that could wear googly eyes — every summonable living entity, whether or not it has an eye config yet — so the picker can be used on any of them without hunting each one down in survival.
PickerState
In-world eye-placement authoring state, driven by the /sg CLI and the keyboard picker, which share this state.

One authored entity's export payload: its config plus the age it was authored under.
PickerState.DraftVariant

PickerState.ListedEye
One saved eye plus the part token it attaches to.

ServerServices

SomeGooglyCommon
Mod identity shared by every platform.

TomlConfig

VersionRangeMatcher
Minimal matcher for exact versions and bracket ranges such as [1.2.0,1.3.0), plus the nearest-generation fallback pick (nearestVersion(java.util.Collection<java.lang.String>, java.lang.String)) used when no entry matches at all and the range synthesis (rangeFor(java.lang.String)) used when exporting definitions for optional mods.
